rationale: Fault on l23 must be isolated by opening it. This isolates b3 and b4 from the source. To restore high-priority loads (b3: priority 5, b4: priority 2), close tie_24 to energize b4 from b2, which also restores b3 via l34. Total restored priority is 10 (3+2+5), meeting the minimum requirement. The network remains radial with path: s-b1-b2-b4-b3.
